text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — we received ApexCloud invoice INV-2026-0456 for $9,600 but there's no PO attached. AP system auto-routed to @Jonas. PDF uploaded as invoice_0456.pdf

Jonas Kim: I pulled the PDF. Procurement Bot suggests PO-23456 but PO amount shows $9,000. Invoice is $9,600. Can @Procurement Bot confirm match reason?

Procurement Bot: Match summary: vendor=ApexCloud, invoice=INV-2026-0456, invoice_amount=9600, matched_po=PO-23456, po_amount=9000, variance=+600 (+6.7%). Suggested approver group: infra-leads (primary approver: Lena Ortiz). Recommendation: route to infra lead for PO exception OR submit PO change request.

Lena Ortiz: I'm OOO today and back 10/21. If that extra $600 is an overage for metered usage, we can approve it to infra budget. If it's a subscription bump, we need a new PO. Can someone confirm invoice line items?

Tom Alvarez: We had a short overage last month for extra GPU hours. Likely that. Can someone paste the invoice lines or the line items table?

Maya Patel: Paste of invoice lines:
```
1. ApexCloud - Base subscription - 12 months - $9,000
2. ApexCloud - Usage (GPU hours) - Aug 2026 - 10hr @ $60 = $600
3. Sales tax - $0
Total: $9,600
```

Jonas Kim: That looks like an explicit usage line (line 2). So PO-23456 covers base subscription only. This is a PO variance not a vendor dispute. @Lena when you're back, can you approve the variance to infra? If not, we need a PO change.

Lena Ortiz: Thanks — that matches expectations. I'll review and approve the PO exception when I'm back. Please put payment on hold until I sign off. :+1:

Tom Alvarez: Placed payment hold in AP. (AP hold id: HOLD-7732). Also created a PR in procurement system to update PO if needed: https://procurement.internal/reqs/REQ-998.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. Action items: 1) AP hold = HOLD-7732 (Tom) 2) Proc PR REQ-998 created (Tom) 3) Route to Lena for approval when back (Jonas) 4) I'll add comment to invoice record referencing HOLD-7732 and REQ-998.

Jonas Kim: I'll update the routing rules to prefer infra-leads for ApexCloud invoices > $500 variance to reduce manual hops.

Procurement Bot: Noted. Routing rule update queued (task 4521). Will apply after change window.

Maya Patel: Closing loop — we'll wait for Lena to approve. If no action by EOD 10/22, Finance will escalate to CFO for one-time approval.

Lena Ortiz: Sounds good. Thanks for the quick triage.
